question: Does engineering memory (measured lessons from OTHER creatures) increase how often the AI's selected redesign is verified?
pairing: one fresh challenge run per creature/replicate; two live investigations on it: memory on and memory off; order memory-first on replicate 1, no-memory-first on replicate 2; identical arena seeds within a pair

bank.frozen: the evaluation server runs WITHOUT CF_MEMORY, so no lesson is added during the run

primary_outcome: per investigation: the arena's selected AI arm has verdict VERIFIED_IMPROVEMENT (no AI arm counts as not verified)
primary_analysis: exact one-sided McNemar on discordant pairs (H1: memory-only > no-memory-only), alpha 0.05. Claim 'memory increased verified redesigns on these creatures' ONLY if p < 0.05; otherwise 'no evidence of a benefit'.
power_note: 12 pairs: low power; a null result is the expected outcome unless the effect is large. Stated before running.
secondary: AI verified rate per arm (Wilson 95% CI)
paired median diff of the AI arm (memory - no memory)
no_retries: a failed investigation is recorded as not verified, never rerun
